normal_queue.skip_condition: object+0x12 == 0xFFFF or mapped slot has the high bit set
normal_queue.interpretation: The normal queue explicitly excludes the cloud object because its logical slot is FFFF. The generic VGA/BOB entry is a real blitter, but it is reached from ordinary DS:6D86 queue entries.

unique_call.interpretation: The controlled probe repeatedly observed the ordinary queue draw, not a WOLKE slot 413-416 call.

queue_boundary_probe.interpretation: Every captured queue append came from the ordinary object renderer, not from a WOLKE-specific explicit queue entry; the cloud remained logical slot FFFF while DS:89E6 was set.

cloud.conclusion: The generic VGA/BOB blitter and ordinary queue are now statically identified. Raw-segment relocation scanning finds only the ordinary queue caller for 01F7:0013 (01F7:35B3 -> return 35B8), and the targeted queue-boundary trace captures only ordinary 01F7:1024 -> 34BC appends. The WOLKE-specific caller or direct record selection remains unresolved; slots 413-416 are still confirmed by archive and cross-world resource evidence.
